subject: Mutual Action Plan — initial draft, owners & two close-path options
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Li <samantha.li@medinova.com>, Carlos Ruiz <c.ruiz@medinova.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Oct 2026 15:12:00 +0000
Subject: Mutual Action Plan — initial draft, owners & two close-path options

Hi Samantha & Carlos,

Thanks again for taking the time today — great conversation and some clear priorities on latency, data isolation, and predictable cost. Per our call I put together an initial Mutual Action Plan (attached) with milestones, proposed owners, and two close-paths so we can pick the right cadence. High level:  

- Milestone A: Pilot integration (POC) — target 3 weeks from kickoff — Owner: Marissa Cole (Redwood) / Integration Lead (Medinova)
- Milestone B: Security & compliance review (SOC2 evidence, network controls) — target 2 weeks — Owner: Neha Kapoor (Redwood) / Security (Medinova)
- Milestone C: Procurement & commercial review — contingent on SOC2 sign-off — Owner: Vivek Kulkarni / Procurement (Medinova)

Two close-path options included in RDW_MAP_v1.xlsx:
A) Aggressive: 6–8 week close (concurrent POC + security eval + procurement prep)
B) Phased: 10–14 week close (sequential: security → POC → procurement)

Ask from you: can you confirm the internal stakeholders we should list on the MAP (integration owner, security reviewer, procurement main contact), and which close-path sounds most realistic for Medinova? Also flag any missing dependencies (e.g., legal review, test data provisioning).

Attachments: RDW_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP draft), SOC2-summary.pdf (high-level evidence we referenced)

If helpful I can sketch an alternative timeline that shortens the POC by focusing on a trimmed integration scope.

Thanks — I’ve CC'd Neha and Marissa so they can own security and POC follow-ups.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
---
Sent from my laptop
From: Samantha Li <samantha.li@medinova.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Carlos Ruiz <c.ruiz@medinova.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 8 Oct 2026 09:07:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan — initial draft, owners & two close-path options

Vivek — thanks for the summary and the quick turn on the MAP. We reviewed internally this morning. A few notes before we lock anything down:

1) Stakeholders — please add Dr. Elena Park (elena.park@medinova.com) as the clinical lead on the POC (she'll sign off on success criteria). Also adding IT Ops (it-ops@medinova.com) as a recipient for network/VPC questions.
2) Security — the SOC2-summary is helpful. Our security team needs a short inventory of data flows and an expected retention policy for logs (14 vs 90 days). Can Neha help with that?
3) Procurement — confirm whether Redwood has a standard SOW template and if there are any pass-through hosting charges we should anticipate.

On timeline: we prefer Option B (Phased) given the compliance gating, but we can accelerate parts of the POC in parallel if Redwood can guarantee a locked-down staging environment.

I'll loop in Procurement separately once we confirm the security path.

Thanks,
Samantha
Director of Product | Medinova Health

Thanks Samantha — appreciate the clear asks. Quick responses:

- Elena added to the stakeholder list in the MAP (I updated the attached spreadsheet).
- Neha: can you confirm a proposed doc (one-pager) that outlines data flows + recommended retention window (14 days default, option to extend to 90 days for longer audit windows)? If you can draft that by Tuesday it will unblock procurement.
- Marissa: can you confirm the minimal POC scope that demonstrates latency & inference correctness (3 endpoints, synthetic data, <2s avg token latency target)? If we can scope that smaller we can run parts in parallel under Option B and potentially compress to ~8 weeks.

Carlos — for procurement questions: we do have a standard SOW + hosting appendix; I'll share templates and transparent cost line-items next week. Vivek (me) will own the commercial cadence.

Attached: updated RDW_MAP_v1.xlsx (v1.1) — note Milestone dates adjusted for phased path.

Best,
Vivek

- Procurement contact for signatures is Ana Gomez (ana.gomez@medinova.com). Ana, I copied you here.
- We prefer Option B but will start procurement packet in parallel as long as the SOC2 evidence and data flow doc are available.
